t: r/FordDiesels on Reddit: Does anyone in here daily a Dually? I’ve been seeing a lot of them for sale near me for cheaper than an SRW, but I can’t imagine daily driving one
s: April 14, 2021 - I almost bought a dually for the same reason, cheaper by a bunch mostly. I am glad I ended up with SRW in the end. With today's tire technology you can tow a ludicrous amount on SRW, it just sways a lot more - but there are air bags to help that. The only way I would buy a dually now is if I owned the trailers that truly need it.
